title: Suola URL normalization rules
description: Schema for rules.yaml, the authored source, and for the build/rules.json it is compiled into. Also validates rule sets passed at runtime to AppendRules or as a custom rules file.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference. Emitted by rules-compile and ignored by the module.

sites.description: Site rules, evaluated in descending order of effective weight.

domain.description: Domain this rule applies to, e.g. "example.com". An empty string is the wildcard rule matching any domain.

weight.description: Explicit priority weight. When omitted, the wildcard domain gets 0 and other domains get 100 + len(domain).

templates.description: Extraction templates, tried in order until one matches.

tests.description: Test cases for this site. Stripped from the embedded build/rules.json; see build/rules.tests.json.

pattern.description: Regex with named groups (?P<Name>...) matched against the URL path. Omit to match any path.

query_params.description: Template field name -> query parameter name to read it from.

transform.description: Field name -> transformation to apply to the extracted value.

signature.description: Expected SHA-256 signature of the normalized URL.

sign.description: Deprecated alias for "signature". Normalized to "signature" by rules-compile.

xfail.description: The URL is expected to have no matching rule.
